decision: Retain current EPA model; no alternative cleared the predeclared validation rules

policy.promotion: no automatic change to published forecasts
policy.refresh: same setting chosen on early-week validation; no independent refresh selection
policy.score_guard: candidate score MAE cannot exceed control by more than 0.05 points
policy.selection: preceding two completed NFL seasons, early-week margin MAE
policy.selection_lock: before first early-week forecast in the evaluation season
policy.ties: margin MAE then fixed profile order; default retained if gain below 0.05
policy.training_window: NFL season count includes the current season; available outcomes only

play_policy.availability: retrospective assumption: kickoff + 24 hours; not upstream publication time
play_policy.defense: opponent offensive EPA on identical eligible plays; lower allowed is better
play_policy.dropback: eligible offense with qb_dropback == 1; includes sacks and scrambles
play_policy.offense: pass or rush flag; finite EPA; exclude no_play, kneels, spikes, two-point tries
play_policy.penalties: retain penalties on eligible plays; exclude no_play/nullified plays
play_policy.rush: eligible offense with rush == 1 and qb_dropback != 1
play_policy.target: final scores including overtime; regular season only
